title: Rajasthan HC Grants Mutual Consent Divorce to Meena Couple Without Proof of Tribal Custom
case_name: Laxmi Meena v. Bahadur Singh Meena
card_summary: A Family Court at Kota had refused a Meena couple's mutual consent divorce because they had not pleaded any community custom governing dissolution. A division bench set that order aside, holding the Hindu Marriage Act's bar on Scheduled Tribes does not apply where the couple admittedly married and lived by Hindu rites. It granted the divorce under Section 13-B and waived the usual six-month cooling-off period.
card_tip: Scheduled Tribe status alone does not bar a mutual consent divorce under the Hindu Marriage Act where the marriage itself followed Hindu rites; the couple need not separately plead a tribal custom for dissolution.
